usedFor: MailChimp holds your audience, and Whatchimp messages new subscribers through “Send WhatsApp Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Send WhatsApp Template” in Whatchimp
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber gets a WhatsApp template message, sent through your Whatchimp account.

watchOut: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” fires for any subscriber, so each one gets the template.
